instructions: Compare the changed clause with the linked clause; they do not contradict. Does the changed clause reach into the linked clause's territory? Answer yes when the changed clause adds a behavior or responsibility inside the boundary the linked clause states for itself or its owner. Answer no when it stays within its own scope, restates the linked clause, or shares no boundary with it.

labels.name: yes
labels.description: The changed clause extends into the scope or boundary the linked clause owns.
